interactions.summary: Jiang rejects the idea that Dante is outgrowing Virgil here and instead reads the shadow panic as insecurity and dependence: Dante still needs constant reassurance from Virgil like a child on pilgrimage.

Jiang then isolates Virgil's theological tercet, insisting that it voices two paradise-level truths already: the Trinity as one substance of love and Mary's birth-giving as the true miracle of redemption.

claims.claim: Jiang says Dante is upset by the missing shadow because he feels abandoned without Virgil, which shows how dependent he has become on his guide.
Jiang frames the Virgil-Dante relation here as father and son, with Dante still needing Virgil to lift him from hell and through the early climb of Purgatory.
Jiang identifies the Trinity's shared substance as love and says this is one of the truths Dante will later state explicitly in Paradise.
Jiang says the deeper miracle is Mary giving birth, not merely Jesus's later sacrifice, and stresses that Virgil is somehow already voicing this paradise truth.

signature_moments.moment: The real shadow problem is not optics but Dante's dependency: he cannot imagine climbing without Virgil right beside him.
signature_moments.source_phrase: he needs virgil constantly beside him
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It keeps the scene psychological rather than merely cosmological.

signature_moments.moment: Virgil suddenly speaks with paradise-level knowledge about Mary and divine love, creating the interpretive crisis that will dominate the next discussion.
signature_moments.source_phrase: this is all coming from the mouth of virgil
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It launches Jiang's suspicion that Virgil carries truths he should not possess from Limbo alone.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's shorthand for the Trinity: three persons sharing the single essence of love.

chronology_notes.note: What begins as a scene of Dantean dependence becomes a theological crisis once Virgil starts voicing truths that Jiang says properly belong to Paradise.
